summary_ja: SA―CVAを用いる最終指定親会社は事前に金融庁長官の承認を受け、取消しがない限りSA―CVAを継続して用いる。
summary_en: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company using the SA-CVA must obtain prior approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency and must continue to use it unless the approval is revoked.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that uses the SA-CVA shall obtain the approval of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency in advance.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has received the approval in the preceding paragraph shall continue to use the SA-CVA, except where the approval is revoked under the provisions of Article 248-4-5.
